_comment: Copy to courses.json (not in git) and fill in. Review links: Articulate Review > a course > Share > copy the review link.
navigation: A Review link to a course whose menu is "restricted" and that has triggers disabling Next/Prev
answers: A Review link to a course with a multiple-choice or true/false quiz
extension: A Review link to a course with a "restricted" menu and a quiz (used for the full extension test)
questionTypesPackage: A published Storyline course (.zip or an unzipped folder) with fill-in, numeric and hotspot questions
